_doc: Cosmetic hero skins (docs/dev/skins.md). Cosmetic only: no stats. 'art' names the folder under assets/art/heroes/<hero>/skins/; a skin whose art is not installed yet is listed as coming soon and cannot be bought. Prices are in gems (330 gems = $4.99 in the shop). Same content hard lines as the base designs (docs/dev/character-briefs.md).
